title: Change an email address or mobile number with Transport for NSW
summary: You can update your email address or mobile phone number linked to Transport for NSW services using a MyServiceNSW Account.
intro:
You can change your email address or mobile phone number with Transport for NSW using a MyServiceNSW Account.

This means your driver licence or vehicle registration details will be changed at the same time as your account details.
what_you_need: The 'NSW Driver Licence' or 'Vehicle registration' service added to your account (if you have a Digital Driver Licence, the driver licence service is already added).

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
If you already have the Driver Licence or Vehicle Registration service added, you'll be taken to 'Personal details'.Go to step 7.

If you do not have a service added, follow the prompts to connect to Transport for NSW and confirm your NSW Driver Licence, Photo Card or vehicle registration details.You'll be taken to ‘My services’.
In the ‘Contact details’ section, select ‘Update’ in the Email address or Mobile number tile.You'll be taken to ‘Personal details’.
In 'Personal details', select ‘Update’ for email or mobile number.
Enter your new email or mobile number.
Select the checkbox to change the details on the driver licence or vehicle registration service.

faqs.q: What do I need to change my contact details?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account and the 'NSW Driver Licence' or 'Vehicle registration' service added to your account.

faqs.q: Will changing my contact details update my driver licence or vehicle registration?
faqs.a: Yes, changing your details will update both your account details and your driver licence or vehicle registration details.
